content.title: Is Target Open or Closed on Easter Sunday 2026?
content.text: Key PointsHere's whether Target will be open for your shopping needs on Easter, April 5.Target encourages employees to spend time with family; online shopping remains available.Other retailers, including Walmart and CVS, will be open for the holiday. Target is a shopping destination for millions of Americans on a weekly, or even more often, basis, but the store will be closed for one day this weekend. The store, according to their official website, is a general merchandise retailer with stores in all 50 states and the District of Columbia. They’re dedicated to the community, with the store adding that “since 1946, we have given 5 percent of our profits to communities in products, cash and through Target Foundation, which today equals millions of dollars a week.” Now, the store is also giving back by giving their workers some time off to spend with their family and friends, which means shoppers will also have to take some time off from their regular shopping routine. All Target Stores Are Closing on April 5, Allowing Employees to Enjoy the Holiday Target will close all of its United States store for the full day on Easter Sunday, which takes place on April 5 this year. It’s rare when Target closes its doors and only happens on major holidays, such as Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas. Guests can still shop 24/7 on Target.com and the Target app, including the Target Circle exclusive Deal of the Day, for pickup or delivery after the Easter holiday, the company said. That means if you need some quick items for Easter dinner, or if you have to fill in where the Easter Bunny disappointed, then you’ll have to find another store to shop at on Sunday. Stores that are open on Easter Sunday include Walmart, Wegmans, Home Depot, CVS Pharmacy, Tractor Supply Co. and IKEA. It’s worth noting that for a handful of years, Target was open on Thanksgiving, but that’s changed. This past holiday, Target stores were closed on Thanksgiving Day, Nov. 27, and reopened on Black Friday. Target Has Nearly 2,000 Stores Across the U.S. “Target makes it easy to find stylish and festive cheer, while discovering something new to love,” they state on their official website. “Our nearly 2,000 stores across the country put our inspiring in-person shopping experience within 10 miles of 75 percent of the U.S. population.” The store opened 18 new locations in 2025, and their “plan to build more than 300 new locations and enhance nearly our entire network in the next decade.” Easter, according to History.com, is a “Christian holiday that celebrates belief in the resurrection of Jesus Christ. In the New Testament of the Bible, the event is said to have occurred three days after Jesus was crucified by the Romans and died in roughly A.D. 30.” They add that Easter ends with the Passion of Christ, “a series of events Jesus experienced in his final days on Earth through his resurrection, and is a major cornerstone of the religion.” About the authorAnne Erickson is a trending news writer for Men's Journal. She's an award-winning reporter who covers sports and entertainment.
